payload.title: Cold-evict bare `git commit` sweeps a concurrent worker's staged index (shared-index race) — corrupts commit hygiene + pushes unverified in-flight code
payload.defect: _step55_git_commit_evict() does `git add "$ORCH_STATE_PATH" "$archive_path"` (correctly scoped) then a BARE `git commit -m` with NO pathspec. A bare commit commits the ENTIRE staged index, not just the two files this function staged. When any other process (a dev-team-spawned worker mid-commit) has already `git add`/`git rm`'d its files but not yet run its own `git commit`, the cold-evict's bare commit greedily captures those staged files too.

observed_incident.actually_contained: the legitimate orch-state.json cold-evict PLUS dev-mcp-server's in-flight UC-MDH-P1 staged work: apps/mcp-server/src/__tests__/1300b-agent-memory-update-tools.test.ts (+50), apps/mcp-server/src/interface/mcp/tools/system/agentMemoryUpdateTools.ts (+8), 3 test-artifact .md deletions, ~84 sessions/*.md pollution deletions
observed_incident.downstream_effect: the swept commit was pushed (tsc passed via pre-push hook, but dev-mcp-server had NOT yet run its own `bun test` gate) -> CI run 29508457885 on HEAD 36807df9 went RED on the `bun test` job (ci-red-36807df9-20260716145632.json). The red is OWNED by the still-in-flight UC-MDH-P1 (dev-mcp-server will fix-forward); this signal is for the ROOT CAUSE, not the transient red.

payload.root_cause_fix: Change the cold-evict commit to an EXPLICIT PATHSPEC so it can never capture concurrently-staged worker files: `git -C "$ROOT" commit -m "..." -- "$ORCH_STATE_PATH" "$archive_path"`. Both paths are plain modifications (no renames/deletions), so the pathspec-commit (worktree-not-index) weakness does not apply here. Add a post-commit assertion that the commit's name-only set equals exactly {orch-state.json, archive/<yyyymm>.json}, else emit a bug telegram. This is the cold-evict sibling of the drain-commit pathspec fix already tracked under the po-s143 ULTRACODE-AUDIT-FIXALL mint (drain-signals.md `git add -u` scoping, rows ~235-237) — SAME class, DIFFERENT commit path; coordinate but do not dedup as identical.
payload.recommended_owner: dev-mcp-server or developer (scripts/ zone); route via PO triage
payload.verification_gate: after fix: simulate a worker staging a file in a throwaway repo, run the cold-evict commit, assert the worker's staged file is NOT in the resulting commit and remains staged in the index.
